senses.gloss: pr. n. m.‘Uḳba, ‘Uḳban, (Mar ‘U.), name of several Amoraim and of one Resh Galutha (or two), commonly named Mar‘U.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:2:5">Y. Ber. I, 3ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מר ע׳</he>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 56b:19">Sabb. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>עוקבן בר נחמיה וכ׳</he> ‘U. son of N., the Resh Galutha; a. e.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 34b:9">Erub. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ בר חמא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בר אבא</he>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Berakhot 44a:6">Ber. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>מר ע׳ בר ח׳</he> (Ms. F. <he>רב ע׳</he>).
<cite ref="Zevachim 55b:4">Zeb. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>רב ע׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מר</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:1:26">Y. Erub. I, 18ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>רבי ע׳</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:4:5">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵇ</cite> top <he>ר׳ עוקבה</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:5:7">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵃ</cite> top <he>מר ע׳</he>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:5">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>; Pesik. Ha‘omer, p. 70ᵇ <he>רב חמא בר ע׳</he>.—V. Fr. M’bo p. 120ᵇ, a. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v.
